summary: Join our comprehensive Natural Language Processing (NLP) Training Course. Master essential concepts and practical applications to advance your career in AI.
lede: Natural Language Processing training teaches you to turn unstructured text into structured, actionable intelligence through computational linguistics, machine learning, and Python-based workflows. You will build practical skills in preprocessing, tokenization, lemmatization, vector embeddings, sequence modeling, and transformer fine-tuning. The course covers the full NLP project lifecycle, from preparing noisy text to deploying fine-tuned large language models. You will practice creating sentiment analysis engines, automated summarizers, and vector-based search systems with tools such as Pinecone and LangChain, while addressing limited labeled data, computational costs, model evaluation, scalability, and ethical AI governance.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for technical professionals and data-driven leaders who are responsible for implementing or overseeing AI-driven text analysis within their organizations.
modules: Sequence Modeling with RNNs and LSTMs
Transfer Learning with BERT and RoBERTa
Information Extraction and Named Entity Recognition
Large Language Models and Generative AI
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of Python programming, including familiarity with libraries like Pandas and NumPy. Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts (supervised vs. unsupervised learning) and linear algebra is recommended to fully engage with the neural network modules.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
